nom: Borghese Fango Purificante Purifying Mud for Face and Body

avis.texte: I have been loving this purifying mud mask! It's perfect for my oily skin because it balances my skin and helps remove blemishes. The packaging is so nice, with a latch closure to ensure it's sealed shut. I love using the spatula for easy application on my face, so glad this was offered by Borghese!

I really liked using this product. My skin felt refreshed, clean, and smooth after using it. I have oily skin, and it helped with excess oil without making my face feel dry. It balanced my skin and gave it a lovely, fresh look. I would definitely use this product again.

This mask was complimentary from borghese. I have loved using this mask all over my face and body. It has been keeping my skin looking soft and supple. This product keeps me looking fresh and rejuvenated.

I have never heard of this product line before being gifted this face and body mask complimentary from borghese in exchange for an honest review. From packaging itself, it felt luxurious in the jar with the applicator. Then I scooped some up and applied it to my hands and face and my first opinion was oh this smells very nice but not over powering. I left it on for 5 minutes for it to slightly dry and removed it and I have to say I enjoy how smooth and soft my face looks and my hands feel after this. Within 5 minutes it cleansed my hands and face and I very much enjoyed using it. I'm excited to learn more about this company and will be sharing this mask with my friends and family.

gifted by Borghese. The packaging is gorgeous and I love the jar. Works really well on my skin in all the places. You get a spackle brush thats very nice to spread the mud everywhere. I use the mud everywhere because it feels great on my skin and easy to appy.

It comes in a beautifully crafted jar and also includes a brush to help you apply the mud all over my body and face. This was incredibly soothing and therapeutic. After washing it off my skin felt very soft and I felt relaxed. This is similar to a luxurious mud mask from a resort

This was gifted by Borghese! I do a weekly mud mask and this is the best one I've tried! I'm obsessed with the packaging, it looks and feels so luxurious and the applicator makes it so easy to apply the mask. It left my skin looking so clear and bright, I absolutely love it!

I have combo, acne-prone skin and was excited to try this mask. Formulated for face and body, this is a quick treatment (5 minutes!) that helps to remove impurities and balance my skin without drying. This delivers fast results which is great. Gifted by Borghese.

I really love this mask. I have combination skin and enjoyed using it on my face and body before a shower. The consistency is smooth and it's easy to apply, and my skin felt so soft and soothed after using it. I've added it to my weekly body care routine. Complimentary from Borghese

I just tried Borghese's Fango Purificante Mud Mask, and I'm really impressed! With my combo skin, it made my face feel clean and soft without drying me out. Plus, it works for both face and body! If you're looking for a quick way to pamper yourself, give it a shot. It's a mini spa for me. Highly recommend it gifted by Borghese

A mask brush is a must-have for mess free application. It does start to sting on the skin after a few minutes, but the stinging is mild. Rinsing off was fairly simple with warm water and the help of a washcloth. My skin did feel sensitive to the touch right afterwards but the sensitivity only lasted for a few minutes. This mask left my skin feeling super smooth and soft in just 5 minutes! I'm impressed by the results and this mask has earned a permanent spot in my skincare routine. Gifted by Borghese.

I love the way this mud mask makes my skin feel after a long day. The texture is realy rich and thick, but it spreads over my face smoothly and feels so cooling as it sits. I use this once a week when I want to deep clean my pores and get that polished, fresh look at home. gifted by Borghese

I'm so impressed with Fango Purificante purifying mud mask by Borghese. I have oily blemish-prone skin and I've been struggling with excessive oil production, acne and clogged pores. This mud mask made a big difference in my skin. Every time I use this mask it feels like a spa experience. In just 5 minutes my complexion feels smoother, calmer, more balanced and my pores look clearer. I love how this purifying mask is being effective and gentle on my skin. My skin looks less shiny and my redness has been reduced. I use a double sided applicator to apply and remove the mask and it's very convenient and applies the exact amount I need. This mask has become a part of my skincare routine. Complimentary from borghese.

I have combination skin that can feel congested in some areas and dry in others, and this mud worked really well for me. After rinsing, my skin felt deeply cleansed but still comfortable not tight or stripped. I love that it can be used on both my face and body, making it perfect for areas that need extra purification. My skin looks clearer, smoother, and more balanced after using it. Gifted by Borghese

Gifted by borghese. I really loved this product, it is perfect for an at home spa day, This is one of my favorite products I have tried from this brand, and I really appreciate how beautiful it makes my skin look!

Gifted by Borghese. This is a very luxurious mud mask, perfect for anyone looking to detox their pores. I am a huge fan of this brand, and I am really grateful I got to try it out. I noticed that my skin was visibly smoother!

Wow was my first impression when I received this product. The packaging is so beautiful and high quality. The product itself is even better! I love the texture of this mud mask and it was so easy to apply. After rinsing off, my skin immediately felt so clean and refreshed and I didn't find this product to be drying or irritating. I am absolutely loving this one!! I received this product complimentary from Borghese in exchange for my honest opinion.

Gifted by Borghese. I use the Fango Purificante Purifying Mud mask on both my face and body. I like how I can have an at home spa treatment with this product. It makes my skin feel so clean and clear. Especially since I have oily skin, it helps reduce excess oil.
